title: Zone Event Description
description: Send a robot to a named zone. Optional hints say which waypoint in the zone to prefer.

zone_name.description: The unique name of the target zone.

hints.description: Ordered preferences, most preferred first. The zone manager takes the first hint it can satisfy.

hint.description: One preference: where to park, and facing which way. Name a group, or a waypoint, or neither to accept any waypoint in the zone.

waypoint.description: An internal vertex of the zone, by name or by navigation graph index.

orientations.description: Headings in radians the robot may park at. Omit to accept any.
